summary: This room glues together three unrelated things for weave logistics — the ten-entry Cross-Domain Resonances teaching library, the four-entry Modes of Collaboration family, and two archived-Dialectic transcripts that live inside other entries' bundle folders — and they should be read as three separate families, not one. The Cross-Domain Resonances set is the healthiest thing I read all session: ten entries sharing one deliberate template, no forced links, no generic forward vectors, and — checked carefully — no missing contradicts and no redundant pairs worth merging, despite Loudon's "cluttered" worry; it reads like a designed curriculum, not sprawl. The one real thread worth naming is that four of the ten quietly teach the same underlying lesson (constraint/irreversibility as what produces taste) without that lesson ever being named as its own idea anywhere. The Modes of Collaboration family is where the actual news is: Dialectic, Excellent Adventure, and Oblique Portrait have all badly cleared the SCHEMA hub threshold (18, 18, and 13 inbound against a bar of 5) and nobody has proposed promotion — this Weave is the moment SCHEMA says to make that call. The two archived Dialectics (Spinoza/Zhuangzi on striving, and Zhuangzi/Epictetus/Confucius on the self) are genuinely earning their keep — one spawned The Drift as a new entry, the other directly answered a forward vector the first one carried — but both violate SCHEMA §3's title-must-match-filename rule and sit in an unusual bundle-folder-but-full-entry position that's worth a filename fix rather than a demotion, since they're too load-bearing to hide from Weave topology. One genuine cross-family bridge surfaced on a close read: Dialectic's own text already names its relationship to Making a Palace Citizen (research good enough to embody is research good enough to deposit) but never wired the link.
